item.description: - Rhino uses much less memory when you're not dictating. Whisper models now leave memory after 5 idle minutes and reload when you start recording, and the AI cleanup model waits for your first recording instead of loading at launch. - With "Pause media during recording" on, YouTube in Chrome now picks back up after you dictate instead of staying paused. It stays paused, as before, if two tabs were playing, if Music or Spotify was also playing, or if Chrome isn't in English.

- Dictating into Chrome works every time again. Since 0.1.41, a busy page such as claude.ai could take the paste after Rhino had already put your previous clipboard back, so your old clipboard got pasted instead of your words. Rhino now waits until the app has taken your words before it puts the clipboard back.

- New: Settings → Output → Capitals → Sentence case. Turn it off and dictations go in lowercase without a closing period, ready to drop into the middle of a sentence, including in Gmail, Google Docs and other web apps where Rhino can't see the text around your cursor. Names, "I" and questions keep their capitals and question marks, and saying "period" still adds one. - Brit mode: turn on Settings → Output → Language → Brit mode and English dictations come out as colour, organise, centre and travelled instead of color, organize, center and traveled, and "Hi, Steve" or "Thanks, Steve" become "Hi Steve" and "Thanks Steve". Names like Pearl Harbor stay as they are, and so do your dictionary words. It's on already if your Mac's region is the UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand or South Africa.
